instruction: Save the Impress file as a PNG image named slide_image.png on the Desktop. Follow the default export settings.

metadata.explanation: Checks that the exported PNG has dimensions within expected ranges. The presentation is 16:9 aspect ratio, so width should be 600-2000px and height 400-1500px. Verified: LibreOffice default export produces images within these ranges.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all key requirements: file existence, correct path (/home/user/Desktop/slide_image.png), PNG format, and reasonable dimensions
Getter logic is sound: uses get_vm_file to fetch from VM, PIL to extract image properties (width, height)
Metric logic is correct: 30% for file existence, 35% each for width/height ranges (600-2000px width, 400-1500px height)
Dimension ranges are semantically correct for LibreOffice Impress 16:9 slides with default export settings
Edge cases properly handled: missing files, PIL errors, invalid paths all return exists=False
While 'default export settings' cannot be directly verified, checking output dimensions is a reasonable proxy
